**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 of the Cobalt Cloud agreement meets the WARRANTY rule at the preferred level:

- **Professional/workmanlike** — § 19.1 ("by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards").
- **Conformance to documentation** — § 19.1 (Services and Deliverables) and § 19.2.
- **Duration** — Deliverables: 90 days from later of delivery or acceptance; hosted software (inside the defined "Services", § 1.7) conforms *throughout the subscription term*, which meets or beats the 12-month software parameter.
- **Remedies** — § 19.4 gives re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination plus refund of Fees paid if not cured; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **Compliance with law / no malicious code** — § 19.3.
- **Disclaimer does not swallow the warranty** — § 19.5 ("No disclaimer limits an express warranty…").

Noted in rationale only (not deviations): the malicious-code warranty is limited to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and Deliverable conformance runs 90 days rather than 12 months — mitigated by the full-term hosted conformance warranty and the § 6.2 acceptance-cycle refund right.
